text: Sorry to trouble you, I'm probably fussing. Grandson is 5 and is staying with me tonight. His temperature is 38 according to my thermometer, though I'm not sure how good it is. He doesn't look himself, his face has gone a funny washed out colour and there's a sort of mottled look on his legs, and I think his lips are paler than they should be. And he keeps putting his arm over his eyes when I put the bedside lamp on, says it hurts and asks me to turn it off. I don't know if I'm worrying over nothing but he's never done that before.
